passages.head: Participants: Liam Chen, Priya Nair, Derek Moss
passages.text:
Liam Chen (11:15 A.M.):
Hi Priya and Derek. I'm at the convention center setting up our booth for the CleanTech Expo, but I only see three boxes of promotional tote bags. Didn't we order five boxes?

Priya Nair (11:17 A.M.):
We did. Five boxes were delivered to the office yesterday afternoon. Wait—Derek loaded the company van this morning. Derek, did all five make it in?

Derek Moss (11:20 A.M.):
Oh, no! I just checked the storage closet by the loading dock. Two boxes were sitting behind the poster stands, so I missed them when loading the van. I'm really sorry about that.

Liam Chen (11:22 A.M.):
Don't worry about it. The expo floor doesn't open to attendees until 2:00 P.M., and three boxes are more than enough for the afternoon session anyway.

Derek Moss (11:24 A.M.):
I'm driving over at 1:30 P.M. to take the first shift at the booth with you, Liam. I can easily put the remaining two boxes in the trunk of my car and bring them straight to Hall B.

Priya Nair (11:26 A.M.):
That works out well. While you're still at the office, Derek, could you also grab the extra power strip from my desk drawer? The booth lighting needs an extra outlet.

Derek Moss (11:27 A.M.):
Consider it done! See you both soon.
passages.trans:
Liam Chen (上午 11:15)：
嗨 Priya、Derek。我人正在會展中心布置我們 CleanTech 博覽會的攤位，但我只看到三箱宣傳托特包。我們不是訂了五箱嗎？

Priya Nair (上午 11:17)：
我們確實訂了五箱。昨天下午有五箱送到辦公室。等等——今天早上是 Derek 把東西搬上公司廂型車的。Derek，五箱都有搬上車嗎？

Derek Moss (上午 11:20)：
糟了！我剛去檢查了卸貨區旁邊的儲藏室。有兩箱放在海報架後面，所以我裝車時漏掉了。真的很抱歉。

Liam Chen (上午 11:22)：
別擔心。展場下午 2:00 才對與會者開放，而且不管怎樣，三箱應付下午的場次已經綽綽有餘了。

Derek Moss (上午 11:24)：
Liam，我下午 1:30 會開車過去跟你一起負責攤位的第一班輪值。我可以順便把剩下的兩箱放進我後車廂，直接帶去 B 展廳。

Priya Nair (上午 11:26)：
那太好了。Derek，趁你還在辦公室，可以幫我從我辦公桌抽屜拿那條備用延長線嗎？攤位燈光需要多一個插座。

Derek Moss (上午 11:27)：
包在我身上！待會見。

passages.head: Vanguard Logistics — Regional Fleet Coordinator (Denver, CO)
passages.text:
Vanguard Logistics, a premier freight and cold-chain transportation provider serving the Mountain West, is seeking a detail-oriented Regional Fleet Coordinator to join our Denver operations center.

Key Responsibilities:
• Monitor daily dispatch schedules for a fleet of 65 refrigerated delivery trucks.
• Coordinate preventive maintenance and emergency repairs with certified external service garages.
• Review driver electronic logs to ensure full compliance with federal transportation safety regulations.
• Prepare monthly fuel-efficiency and on-time delivery reports for senior management.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business administration, or a related field (or at least four years of equivalent dispatch experience).
• Proficiency in fleet-tracking software and spreadsheet analysis.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle time-sensitive routing changes calmly.
• Commercial driver's license (CDL) is NOT required, though familiarity with cold-storage freight handling is a distinct advantage.

Application Process:
Interested candidates should submit a résumé and a brief cover letter to careers@vanguardlogistics.com by November 10. Please include job code Den-FC26 in the subject line. Only applicants selected for an initial video interview will be contacted.
passages.trans:
Vanguard 物流公司是服務美國山間西部地區的頂尖貨運與冷鏈運輸供應商，目前正徵求一位注重細節的「區域車隊協調員」加入我們的丹佛營運中心。

主要職責：
• 監控 65 輛冷藏配送卡車車隊的每日派遣時程。
• 與認證的外部維修廠協調預防性保養及緊急維修事宜。
• 審查駕駛員電子行車紀錄，確保完全符合聯邦運輸安全法規。
• 為高階管理層編製每月的燃油效率與準時交貨報告。

資格條件：
• 供應鏈管理、企業管理或相關領域學士學位（或至少四年同等派遣調度工作經驗）。
• 熟練操作車隊追蹤軟體與試算表分析。
• 具備強大的問題解決能力，能冷靜應對具時效壓力的路線變更。
• 「不」需具備職業駕照（CDL），但熟悉冷藏貨運處理者尤佳。

應徵方式：
有意應徵者請於 11 月 10 日前將履歷與簡短求職信寄至 careers@vanguardlogistics.com，並請於郵件主旨欄註明職缺代碼 Den-FC26。僅獲選參加初試視訊面試的應徵者會收到聯繫。

passages.text:

• Items must be unused, unassembled, and in their original packaging with all hardware and instruction manuals included.
• Custom-upholstered sofas, clearance items marked "Final Sale," and opened bedding sets cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged.

How to Initiate a Return:
1. Log in to your account at www.nordichomegoods.com/returns and enter your order number.
2. Print the prepaid return shipping label generated by the portal.
3. Drop off the package at any authorized courier location within 7 days of generating the label.

Refunds & Fees:
• For standard returns, a flat return shipping fee of $15 will be deducted from your refund. However, if you opt for a store credit voucher or an exchange of equal value, the $15 shipping fee is waived.
• If an item arrives defective or damaged in transit, please email photos of the damage to support@nordichomegoods.com within 48 hours of delivery for a free replacement.
• Refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after our warehouse inspects the returned merchandise.

passages.head: Lumina Botanical Gardens — Seasonal Visitor Notice
passages.text:
Thank you for visiting Lumina Botanical Gardens! Please take note of several updates taking effect this autumn (October 1–November 30):

1. Glasshouse Conservatory Closure
The Tropical Glasshouse will be closed to the public from October 12 through October 26 while technicians install a climate-control filtration system. All outdoor trails, the Japanese Maple Pavilion, and the Orchid Gallery will remain open during regular hours (8:30 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. daily).

2. Reduced Admission & Member Perks
During the two-week Glasshouse closure, general adult admission will be reduced from $18 to $14. In addition, annual pass holders may bring one guest free of charge on any weekday in October.

3. Guided Walking Tours
Complimentary 45-minute walking tours focusing on autumn foliage depart from the Visitor Center patio at 10:30 A.M. and 2:00 P.M. every Saturday and Sunday. Space is limited to 20 participants per group; sign-up sheets are available at the information desk starting at 8:30 A.M. on the day of the tour.

4. Café Relocation
While the main Garden Café terrace is being repaved, light refreshments and bottled beverages can be purchased at the pop-up kiosk next to the gift shop.

Hannah Cho (2:05 P.M.):
Team, quick update on the Aurora Smart Lamp launch event in Chicago on November 6. The Grand Ballroom at the Drake Hotel just informed us that their ceiling projector is undergoing repairs that week, so we need a backup display plan for the keynote demo.

Victor Alvarez (2:07 P.M.):
That's frustrating. Can we rent a large LED video wall from a local audiovisual vendor in Chicago?

Hannah Cho (2:09 P.M.):
I already called two AV rental companies. An LED wall costs $3,200 for a single day, which puts us $1,400 over our remaining event budget. However, the hotel offered to reduce our room rental fee by $800 because of the broken projector.

Mei-Ling Wu (2:12 P.M.):
Wait—if the hotel gives us an $800 credit, we're only $600 short. Remember that we decided yesterday to print digital QR-code handouts instead of glossy booklets? That saved $950 in printing costs.

Hannah Cho (2:14 P.M.):
You're right, Mei-Ling! I hadn't updated the master spreadsheet with the printing savings yet. That means we can cover the LED wall after all.

Victor Alvarez (2:16 P.M.):
Fantastic! The LED screen will actually look much sharper than a standard projector in a bright room. I'll adjust the presentation slides to widescreen 16:9 format this afternoon so they fit the LED wall properly.

等等——如果飯店折抵 800 美元，我們就只差 600 美元。還記得我們昨天決定印製數位 QR 碼單張，而不印亮面小冊子嗎？那筆印刷費省下了 950 美元。

passages.head: PORTLAND (May 18) — Business Weekly
passages.text:
Cascadia Roasters, a specialty coffee chain based in Portland, Oregon, announced yesterday that it will acquire Sunbelt Bakery, a family-owned wholesale pastry producer in Eugene. Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed, though industry analysts estimate the deal to be worth approximately $12 million.

Founded twelve years ago by CEO Clara Jennings, Cascadia Roasters currently operates 38 cafés across Oregon and Washington. For the past four years, Sunbelt Bakery has been the primary supplier of croissants, muffins, and artisan bread for Cascadia's southern Oregon locations. [1]

"Bringing Sunbelt Bakery into the Cascadia family is a natural next step for us," said Ms. Jennings at Tuesday's press briefing. "It allows us to guarantee consistent quality across all our stores while introducing freshly baked gluten-free items to our Seattle and Tacoma branches for the first time." [2]

Under the agreement, Sunbelt Bakery's Eugene facility will be expanded by 15,000 square feet this autumn, creating 25 new full-time baking and packaging jobs. [3] Sunbelt's current director of operations, Mateo Silva, will stay on to oversee the Eugene plant and report directly to Ms. Jennings. [4]
passages.trans:
波特蘭（5 月 18 日）—《商業週刊》

總部位於奧勒岡州波特蘭的精品連鎖咖啡品牌 Cascadia Roasters 昨日宣布，將收購位於尤金市（Eugene）的家族經營批發烘焙製造商 Sunbelt Bakery。該協議的財務條款並未公開，但產業分析師估計這筆交易價值約 1,200 萬美元。

Cascadia Roasters 由執行長 Clara Jennings 於十二年前創立，目前在奧勒岡州與華盛頓州經營 38 間咖啡館。過去四年來，Sunbelt Bakery 一直是 Cascadia 南奧勒岡州各分店可頌、瑪芬與手工麵包的主要供應商。[1]

Jennings 女士在週二的記者會上表示：「將 Sunbelt Bakery 納入 Cascadia 大家庭對我們而言是順理成章的下一步。這不僅能讓我們確保所有門市的品質一致，更能首次將新鮮現烤的無麩質烘焙品引進我們的西雅圖與塔科馬分店。」[2]

根據該協議，Sunbelt Bakery 位於尤金市的廠房將於今年秋季擴建 15,000 平方英尺，創造 25 個新的全職烘焙與包裝工作機會。[3] Sunbelt 現任營運總監 Mateo Silva 將留任，繼續管理尤金廠並直接向 Jennings 女士報告。[4]

passages.head:
For Immediate Release — October 8
Aether Mobility Launches Bike-Sharing Program in Austin
passages.text:
AUSTIN, TX — Aether Mobility today unveiled AetherRide, an electric-assist bicycle-sharing network designed to make short urban commutes faster and more sustainable. Starting October 15, residents and visitors will be able to unlock 800 pedal-assist e-bikes parked at 65 solar-powered docking stations across downtown Austin and the University District.

Unlike dockless scooters that are often left on sidewalks, AetherRide bicycles must be returned to an official docking station at the end of each trip. The stations recharge the bikes' batteries automatically using overhead solar canopies.

"We worked closely with the Austin Department of Transportation for over a year to select station locations near bus hubs and major employment centers," said Aether Mobility Chief Operating Officer Kenji Takahashi. "Our goal is to bridge the 'first-and-last-mile' gap for public transit riders."

Single rides cost $1.50 to unlock plus $0.20 per minute. Commuters can also purchase a Monthly Unlimited Pass for $29, which covers unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes each. To celebrate the launch, anyone who downloads the AetherRide mobile app before October 31 will receive three complimentary 30-minute rides.

立即發布 — 10 月 8 日
Aether Mobility 於奧斯汀推出共享單車計畫

德州奧斯汀訊 — Aether Mobility 今日發表了 AetherRide 電動輔助共享單車網路，旨在讓都會短程通勤更快速且更具永續性。自 10 月 15 日起，居民與遊客將可在奧斯汀市中心與大學區共 65 座太陽能充電樁站點，解鎖租借 800 輛電動輔助自行車。

不同於常被隨意停放在人行道上的無樁滑板車，AetherRide 自行車在每趟行程結束後都必須歸還至官方站點。站點會利用頂棚的太陽能板自動為單車電池充電。

Aether Mobility 營運長高橋健司表示：「我們與奧斯汀交通局密切合作超過一年，挑選靠近公車轉運站與主要就業中心的站點位置。我們的目標是為大眾運輸乘客銜接『第一哩與最後一哩路』的落差。」

單次騎乘解鎖費為 1.50 美元，另加每分鐘 0.20 美元。通勤族也可購買每月 29 美元的月票（Monthly Unlimited Pass），可享不限次數、每次最長 45 分鐘的騎乘。為慶祝服務上線，凡於 10 月 31 日前下載 AetherRide 手機應用程式者，皆可獲贈三次免費的 30 分鐘騎乘體驗。

docs.text:
Our company ordered the pasta buffet for 35 employees for an all-day training session last Tuesday. The food itself was excellent — the pasta was hot and the salad was very fresh, and several colleagues asked where it came from.

However, the delivery arrived 40 minutes after the time we had requested, so our lunch break had to be shortened. I was also disappointed that the dessert tray promised on the company's price list was not included with our order. I would consider ordering again, but only if these problems are addressed.

docs.head: Response from Sofia Marino, Owner (October 4)
docs.text:
Dear Mr. Lau,

Thank you for your honest feedback, and I apologize for the problems with your order. On the day of your event, a road closure on Bay Street forced our driver to take a much longer route. In addition, the missing dessert tray was an oversight by a new member of our kitchen staff.

Since your office is located about 15 kilometers from our kitchen, you were charged for delivery. I have refunded that fee to your credit card, and I hope you will give us another chance to serve your team.

【第一篇：價目表】Olive & Thyme 外燴 — 辦公室午餐方案：方案一 精緻三明治拼盤每人 12 美元；方案二 義大利麵自助餐附田園沙拉每人 18 美元；方案三 烤鮭魚餐附季節蔬菜每人 25 美元。30 人以上訂單贈送甜點盤；廚房 10 公里內免運，其他地區收 20 美元運費；所有訂單須至少提前 48 小時下訂。
【第二篇：線上評論】Henry Lau，三顆星，10 月 3 日：上週二公司為全天訓練的 35 位員工訂了義大利麵自助餐。餐點本身很棒，麵是熱的、沙拉很新鮮，好幾位同事問是哪裡訂的。但送達時間比我們要求的晚了 40 分鐘，午休只好縮短；價目表上承諾的甜點盤也沒有附上，令人失望。如果這些問題能改善，我會考慮再訂。
【第三篇：回覆】店主 Sofia Marino，10 月 4 日：感謝您坦率的意見，對訂單的問題深感抱歉。活動當天 Bay 街封路，司機只能繞遠路；甜點盤遺漏則是廚房新進員工的疏失。由於貴公司距離我們廚房約 15 公里，當時有收取運費，我已將這筆費用退回您的信用卡，希望您願意再給我們一次服務的機會。
passages.en: Questions 196-200 refer to the following price list, online review, and response.

qs.q: Why are two boxes of tote bags missing from the expo booth?
o: Liam accidentally left them in the parking lot.
The supplier failed to deliver them on time.
Priya sent them to the wrong convention hall.
Derek overlooked them in the storage closet.
qs.h: 看 11:20 A.M. Derek Moss 的訊息，他說兩箱袋子放在哪裡、為什麼沒搬上車？
qs.trans: 為什麼博覽會攤位少了兩箱托特包？
qs.e: 在 11:20 A.M. 的訊息中，Derek 表示那兩箱放在儲藏室的海報架後面，他裝車時沒看到而漏掉了（so I missed them when loading the van），overlooked 與 missed 同義，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (B) 五箱昨天下午都已送到辦公室；(A) 是 Derek 裝車時留在辦公室儲藏室，不是 Liam 留在停車場；(C) Priya 並未寄送箱子。

qs.q: At 11:27 A.M., what does Mr. Moss most likely mean when he writes, "Consider it done"?
o: He just ordered more tote bags from the vendor.
He will certainly bring the power strip Priya requested.
He has already finished setting up the booth lighting.
He has completed his shift at the convention center.
qs.h: 對照前一則（11:26 A.M.）Priya 請 Derek 順便幫忙拿什麼東西。
qs.trans: 在上午 11:27，Derek 寫道「Consider it done（包在我身上）」是什麼意思？
qs.e: 11:26 A.M. Priya 請 Derek 趁還在辦公室時，順便從她辦公桌抽屜拿備用延長線（grab the extra power strip），Derek 回覆「Consider it done!」這句常見口語慣用語意為「沒問題、包在我身上（當作已經辦好了）」，表示他一定會幫她帶延長線過去，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (C) 他人還在辦公室，尚未去展場裝燈；(D) 他下午 1:30 才要去值第一班；(A) 袋子沒有少訂，只是留在儲藏室。

qs.q: What is one responsibility of the Regional Fleet Coordinator?
o: Negotiating freight contracts with new retail clients
Ensuring that drivers' logs follow safety laws
Repairing damaged vehicles in the company garage
Driving refrigerated trucks across the Mountain West
qs.h: 核對 Key Responsibilities 的四個項目，注意 compliance with federal transportation safety regulations。
qs.trans: 區域車隊協調員的職責之一是什麼？
qs.e: 主要職責第三點為「Review driver electronic logs to ensure full compliance with federal transportation safety regulations」，即檢查駕駛紀錄以確保符合安全法規，與 (B) 完全相符。
qs.w: (D) 資格條件說明不需職業駕照（CDL is NOT required），職責是監控派遣而非親自開車；(A) 文中未提及與新客戶洽談貨運合約；(C) 保養與維修是與「外部維修廠（external service garages）」協調，而非自己修車。

qs.q: What gives an applicant an advantage for this position?
o: Living within walking distance of the Denver office
Speaking more than one language fluently
Knowing how to handle temperature-controlled cargo
Having a commercial driver's license
qs.h: 定位 Qualifications 最後一點的「is a distinct advantage」。
qs.trans: 什麼條件能讓應徵者在此職缺中佔有優勢？
qs.e: 資格條件最後一點提到「familiarity with cold-storage freight handling is a distinct advantage」，cold-storage freight（冷藏貨運）即對應 (C) temperature-controlled cargo（溫控貨物）。
qs.w: (D) 文中只說不需要 CDL，並未說有 CDL 是優勢；(A)(B) 文中均未提及。

qs.q: According to the policy, which item is eligible for a standard return?
o: An unopened set of dining chairs in its original box
A sofa made with customer-selected fabric
A clearance floor lamp marked "Final Sale"
A package of bedsheets that has been washed once
qs.h: 比對 Eligibility Conditions 的兩條規定：哪些不能退？哪一個符合 unused, unassembled, and in their original packaging？
qs.trans: 根據政策，下列哪一項商品符合一般退貨資格？
qs.e: 退貨條件規定商品必須「未使用、未組裝且保留原包裝（unused, unassembled, and in their original packaging）」，(A) 未拆封且在原裝箱內的餐椅組完全符合規定。
qs.w: (B) 客製化布料沙發（Custom-upholstered sofas）不可退；(C) 標示 Final Sale 的出清品不可退；(D) 已拆封或洗過的寢具組（opened bedding sets）不可退。

qs.q: How can a customer avoid paying the $15 return shipping fee on a non-defective item?
o: By returning the item within 48 hours of delivery
By paying for the original order with a credit card
By emailing photographs of the item to customer support
By choosing a store credit voucher instead of a refund
qs.h: 查看 Refunds & Fees 第一點第二句「the $15 shipping fee is waived」的條件。
qs.trans: 對於非瑕疵商品，顧客如何免付 15 美元的退貨運費？
qs.e: Refunds & Fees 第一點說明「However, if you opt for a store credit voucher or an exchange of equal value, the $15 shipping fee is waived」，選擇商店購物金抵用券或等值換貨即可免除 15 美元運費，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A)(C) 48 小時內寄照片是針對「運送損壞或瑕疵品（defective or damaged in transit）」的免費換新規定；(B) 文中未提及信用卡付款可免退貨運費。

qs.q: Why was Horizon Biotech not charged a delivery fee?
o: The total cost of the order exceeded $2,500.
The event was held in the same building as the caterer.
Samuel Lindqvist used a first-time customer coupon.
Horizon Biotech picked up the food itself.
qs.h: 查看表格下方「Delivery & Setup Fee」括號內的說明。
qs.trans: 為什麼 Horizon 生技公司沒有被收取外送費？
qs.e: 帳單明細寫道「Delivery & Setup Fee (Waived for orders over $2,500): $0.00」，因為訂單金額超過 $2,500，所以免收外送與布置費，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 活動在 Horizon 生技公司的會議廳舉行，並非外燴公司大樓；(C) 折扣是企業夥伴 9 折優惠，非新客優惠券；(D) 外燴公司有派外送與 4 名現場服務生。

qs.q: What is true about the payment for Invoice #INV-9034?
o: A 10% late fee applies after September 26.
The remaining balance must be paid in cash.
The full amount of $3,636 is due immediately.
Half of the total amount has already been paid.
qs.h: 查看底部 Notes 第一點關於 50% deposit 的說明。
qs.trans: 關於發票 #INV-9034 的付款，下列何者正確？
qs.e: Notes 第一點指出「A 50% deposit ($1,818.00) was paid by corporate credit card on September 10」，表示總金額的一半（50% 訂金）已經付清，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) 只需再付剩餘的一半尾款 $1,818，且期限至 10 月 26 日；(B) 尾款須以銀行匯款或支票（via bank transfer or check）支付，非現金；(A) 逾期滯納金為每月 2%，且到期日為 10 月 26 日。

qs.q: Why did Mr. Vance send the e-mail?
o: To request payment for an overdue invoice
To confirm that an order has been shipped
To explain a change in Oakridge Printing's pricing
To alert a client to a potential printing issue
qs.h: 留意第二段提到的 prepress team noticed... 關於照片解析度過低可能造成模糊的問題。
qs.trans: Vance 先生為何寄這封電子郵件？
qs.e: 第二段指出印前團隊發現內頁有兩張照片解析度低於建議的 300 DPI，直接印製可能會稍微模糊，因此寫信提醒客戶並詢問是否要替換圖檔，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (B) 產品尚未開始正式印刷（Before we proceed with the full print run），還沒出貨；(A) 信中完全未提及帳單或逾期付款；(C) 信中未提及價格變動。

qs.q: How can Ms. Haddad keep her original delivery date of April 19?
o: By reducing the total number of brochures to 300
By picking up the brochures at the printing plant in person
By submitting new image files before 3:00 P.M. on April 15
By paying an expedited shipping fee
qs.h: 定位第三段「keep your original delivery date of April 19」的前一句。
qs.trans: Haddad 女士如何才能維持原定的 4 月 19 日交貨日期？
qs.e: 第三段明確說明，若要替換高解析度圖片，請於 4 月 15 日下午 3:00 前上傳至客戶專區，這樣就能維持原定的 4 月 19 日交貨日（Doing so will allow us to keep your original delivery date of April 19），故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 300 是建議的解析度 300 DPI，印刷數量是 2,500 份；(D) 文中未提及急件運費；(B) 文中未提及親自到印刷廠取件。

qs.q: What is indicated about Order #4082?
o: It is the first order Ms. Haddad has placed with Oakridge Printing.
It was submitted through an online system.
It consists of posters and banners for a conference.
It will be delivered on April 17 if no changes are made.
qs.h: 注意第一段提到的「digital files you uploaded this morning」與第三段的「upload them to your client portal」。
qs.trans: 關於訂單 #4082，文中指出了什麼？
qs.e: 第一段提到「您今天早上上傳的數位檔案（digital files you uploaded this morning）」，第三段也提到上傳至 client portal，可知該訂單檔案是透過線上系統提交的，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 文中僅感謝她選擇該公司，未提及是否為首次下單；(D) 原定交貨日是 4 月 19 日，若延遲兩天則是更晚，而非 4 月 17 日；(C) 該訂單是三折頁產品宣傳冊（tri-fold product brochures），而非海報與橫幅。

qs.q: What will NOT be available to visitors from October 12 to October 26?
o: The Orchid Gallery
The outdoor walking trails
The Japanese Maple Pavilion
The Tropical Glasshouse
qs.h: 注意第 1 點標題與內文：哪一個場館在 10 月 12 日至 26 日期間會關閉？
qs.trans: 10 月 12 日至 10 月 26 日期間，遊客「無法」使用下列哪一項設施？
qs.e: 第 1 點明載「The Tropical Glasshouse will be closed to the public from October 12 through October 26」，因此熱帶溫室在此期間不開放，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) Orchid Gallery、(C) Japanese Maple Pavilion 與 (B) outdoor trails 都在第 1 點第二句被列為照常開放（remain open）。

qs.q: According to the notice, how can visitors join a guided walking tour?
o: By signing up at the information desk on the day of the tour
By registering at the pop-up kiosk next to the gift shop
By purchasing a special $14 tour ticket at the gate
By reserving a spot on the garden's website in advance
qs.h: 查看第 3 點 Guided Walking Tours 的最後一句。
qs.trans: 根據公告，遊客如何參加導覽步行團？
qs.e: 第 3 點最後一句說明「sign-up sheets are available at the information desk starting at 8:30 A.M. on the day of the tour」，即當天早上 8:30 起在服務台登記報名，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (D) 文中規定當日現場登記，未提網站事先預約；(C) 導覽團為免費（Complimentary），$14 是溫室關閉期間的成人門票；(B) 禮品店旁的快閃亭是賣輕食飲料的，不是報名處。

qs.q: What benefit is offered to annual pass holders in October?
o: A 20 percent discount at the gift shop
A free beverage at the Garden Café
Priority access to the Tropical Glasshouse
Complimentary admission for one guest on weekdays
qs.h: 定位第 2 點最後一句關於 annual pass holders 的優惠。
qs.trans: 年度通行證持有人在 10 月份可享有什麼福利？
qs.e: 第 2 點指出「annual pass holders may bring one guest free of charge on any weekday in October」，即 10 月份平日可免費帶一位貴賓入園，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (B) 飲料仍須於快閃亭購買；(C) 溫室於施工期間對公眾關閉；(A) 20 是導覽團每梯次人數上限（20 participants），並非禮品店折扣。

qs.q: What problem did Hannah Cho report at 2:05 P.M.?
o: A piece of equipment at the venue will be unavailable.
The hotel ballroom was double-booked for November 6.
The keynote speaker canceled his appearance.
The Aurora Smart Lamp prototypes were delayed in shipping.
qs.h: 查看 2:05 P.M. 訊息中的「their ceiling projector is undergoing repairs that week」。
qs.trans: Hannah Cho 在下午 2:05 回報了什麼問題？
qs.e: Hannah 在 2:05 P.M. 表示飯店大宴會廳的天花板投影機那週正在維修（undergoing repairs），即活動當週場地的投影設備將無法使用，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 宴會廳並未重複預訂；(D) 文中未提產品原型延誤；(C) 文中未提講者取消出席。

qs.q: How much did the team originally have left in their event budget before the hotel credit and printing savings?
qs.trans: 在計入飯店折抵與印刷節省的費用之前，團隊原本的活動預算還剩多少錢？
qs.e: Hannah 在 2:09 P.M. 說：「An LED wall costs $3,200 for a single day, which puts us $1,400 over our remaining event budget.」租金 $3,200 比原本剩餘預算超出 $1,400，因此原本剩餘預算為 $3,200 - $1,400 = $1,800（加上飯店折抵 $800 與印刷省下 $950 後共 $3,550，足以支付 $3,200），故選 (C)。
qs.w: (D) $800 是飯店提供的場租折抵；(B) $1,400 是原本不足的差額；(A) $3,200 是 LED 電視牆的單日租金。

qs.q: What will Victor Alvarez do this afternoon?
o: Update the master budget spreadsheet
Print QR-code handouts for attendees
Negotiate a lower rental rate with the hotel
Reformat the slides for the keynote presentation
qs.h: 查看最後一則（2:16 P.M.）Victor Alvarez 說他今天下午要做什麼。
qs.trans: Victor Alvarez 今天下午會做什麼？
qs.e: 在 2:16 P.M.，Victor 說「I'll adjust the presentation slides to widescreen 16:9 format this afternoon so they fit the LED wall properly」，即重新調整簡報投影片的格式，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 管理預算總表的是 Hannah；(B) 改印 QR 碼傳單是昨天決定的事；(C) 飯店已主動折抵 $800。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
o: To announce that the Seattle office will relocate
To introduce a new facilities director
To ask employees for feedback on security procedures
To explain a change to how employees enter the building
qs.h: 主旨題：看標題列 Subject 與第一段。
qs.e: 備忘錄主旨是 Lobby Security Upgrade and ID Badges，第一段說明 8 月 17 日起大廳改用自動閘門、員工須刷新的晶片識別證才能進入，全文都在說明進出大樓方式的改變，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到辦公室搬遷；(C) 沒有徵求意見；(B) Elena Rostova 是發文者，文中沒有介紹新主管。
qs.trans: 這份備忘錄的目的是什麼？

qs.q: When should an engineer working on the fourth floor go to Room 104?
o: On Friday morning
On Monday, August 17
On Wednesday or Thursday
On Monday or Tuesday
qs.h: 查看備忘錄中間的樓層時程表：Floors 4–5 (Product & Engineering)。
qs.trans: 在四樓工作的工程師應該在什麼時候前往 104 室？
qs.e: 根據備忘錄中的排程表，「Floors 4–5 (Product & Engineering): Wednesday–Thursday, 9:00 A.M.–4:00 P.M.」，四樓工程師應於週三或週四前往，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (D) 週一至週二是 2–3 樓（行銷與業務部）；(A) 週五是 6 樓（財務、人資與法務部）；(B) 8 月 17 日週一是新門禁系統正式啟用的日子。

qs.q: What must employees do to receive their new ID badge?
o: Turn in their old employee badge
Obtain written approval from their department head
Pay a $10 card replacement fee
Complete an online security training module
qs.h: 定位最後一段第一句「as it must be surrendered before a new one can be issued」。
qs.trans: 員工必須做什麼才能領取新的識別證？
qs.e: 最後一段指出「Please bring your current employee badge with you, as it must be surrendered before a new one can be issued」，surrender 意為「繳回、交出」，與 turn in 同義，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (D) 文中未提線上安全訓練；(B) 文中未提需部門主管書面批准；(C) 文中未提及任何換證費用。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Badge photos will be taken only during the hours listed below."
qs.h: 待插入句提到 the hours listed below（下方所列的時段）與拍照，找出前面剛提到拍照、後面緊接著出現時段表的位置。
qs.trans:
下列句子最適合填入標示 [1]、[2]、[3]、[4] 的哪一個位置？
「證件照只會在下方所列的時段拍攝。」
qs.e: [2] 的前一句說 104 室將於下週拍新照片並核發新證，後一句接著說「請依下列時程前往」並列出時段表。待插入句同時呼應「拍照」與「下方的時段」，放在 [2] 最連貫，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) [1] 前面只提到新門禁系統，還沒提到拍照；(C) [3] 已經在時段表之後，listed below 找不到對應；(D) [4] 在講出差員工的臨時通行證，與拍照時段無關。

qs.q: What is indicated about Cascadia Roasters?
o: It already sells Sunbelt Bakery products in some of its stores.
It disclosed that it paid $12 million for Sunbelt Bakery.
It plans to close Sunbelt Bakery's Eugene facility.
It was founded four years ago.
qs.h: 查看第二段最後一句關於過去四年兩家公司的合作關係。
qs.trans: 關於 Cascadia Roasters，文中指出了什麼？
qs.e: 第二段指出「For the past four years, Sunbelt Bakery has been the primary supplier of croissants, muffins, and artisan bread for Cascadia's southern Oregon locations」，表示 Cascadia 的部分門市原本就已經在販售 Sunbelt Bakery 的烘焙產品，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (D) Cascadia 創立於十二年前，四年是兩家公司合作供應的時間；(C) 尤金廠不但不關閉，還要在秋季擴建；(B) 財務條款並未公開（not disclosed），1,200 萬美元是分析師的估計值。

qs.q: What change will take place at the Eugene plant this autumn?
o: It will begin roasting coffee beans.
Its floor space will be increased.
It will relocate to Seattle.
Its operations director will be replaced.
qs.h: 定位最後一段第一句「expanded by 15,000 square feet this autumn」。
qs.trans: 尤金廠今年秋季將有什麼改變？
qs.e: 最後一段指出「Sunbelt Bakery's Eugene facility will be expanded by 15,000 square feet this autumn」，廠房擴建 15,000 平方英尺即代表樓地板空間將會增加（Its floor space will be increased），故選 (B)。
qs.w: (D) 現任營運總監 Mateo Silva 將留任（stay on）；(A) 該廠是烘焙與包裝廠，未提烘豆；(C) 只是將無麩質產品引進西雅圖門市，工廠並未搬遷。

qs.q: What is mentioned about Mateo Silva?
o: He negotiated the price of the acquisition.
He will continue to manage the Eugene facility.
He will move to Seattle to open new cafés.
He founded Cascadia Roasters.
qs.h: 找出 Mateo Silva 出現的段落，注意同義改寫。
qs.e: 最後一段說 Sunbelt 現任營運總監 Mateo Silva「will stay on to oversee the Eugene plant」，即留任並繼續管理尤金廠，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (D) Cascadia 的創辦人是 Clara Jennings；(C) 西雅圖指的是引進無麩質商品的門市，與他無關；(A) 文中只說財務條款未公開，沒有提到他談判價格。
qs.trans: 關於 Mateo Silva，文中提到了什麼？

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"That existing partnership made the acquisition talks proceed smoothly."
qs.h: 注意句中的「That existing partnership（這段既有的合作關係）」指的是前一句提到的哪件事？
qs.trans:
下列句子最適合填入標示 [1]、[2]、[3]、[4] 的哪一個位置？
「這段既有的合作關係使收購談判進展得十分順利。」
qs.e: [1] 的前一句剛好說明「過去四年來，Sunbelt 一直是 Cascadia 南奧勒岡分店的主要供應商」，待插入句的「That existing partnership」完美指代這段長達四年的供應商合作關係，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) [2] 前一句在談引進無麩質商品；(C) [3] 前一句在談擴廠與徵才；(D) [4] 前一句在談營運總監留任，皆無法對應 That existing partnership。

qs.q: How do AetherRide bicycles differ from dockless scooters?
o: They do not require batteries to operate.
They must be parked at designated stations after each use.
They can only be rented by university students.
They are free to use on weekends.
qs.h: 定位第二段第一句「Unlike dockless scooters...」。
qs.trans: AetherRide 自行車與無樁滑板車有何不同？
qs.e: 第二段明確指出「Unlike dockless scooters that are often left on sidewalks, AetherRide bicycles must be returned to an official docking station at the end of each trip」，每次騎乘後都必須歸還至指定的官方站點，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (C) 所有居民與遊客（residents and visitors）皆可租借；(A) 它們是配備電池並由太陽能充電的電動輔助單車；(D) 文中未提及週末免費。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of the AetherRide program?
o: Free rides for people who download the app
A monthly pass for frequent riders
Helmets that are provided at every station
Docking stations powered by solar energy
qs.h: NOT 題：把四個選項逐一回原文核對。
qs.e: 新聞稿提到站點用太陽能頂棚充電（B）、每月 29 美元的月票（C）、10 月 31 日前下載 App 送三次免費騎乘（D），但完全沒有提到每個站點提供安全帽，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (D)(B)(A) 都在新聞稿中提到。
qs.trans: 下列何者「沒有」被提到是 AetherRide 計畫的特色？

qs.q: In the press release, the word "bridge" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
o: delay
construct
close
evaluate
qs.h: 搭配片語「bridge the gap（彌合／縮小差距）」。
qs.trans: 在第三段中，「bridge」一詞的意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 片語「bridge the gap」意為「銜接、彌合、消除（差距或落差）」，在此與「close (the gap)」（縮小／消除落差）意思最接近，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (B) construct 建造（用於實體建築，不用於 construct a gap）；(A) delay 延遲；(D) evaluate 評估。

qs.q: How can users receive three free rides?
o: By downloading the mobile app before the end of October
By referring three friends to the service
By returning a bicycle to a downtown bus hub
By purchasing a Monthly Unlimited Pass
qs.h: 查看最後一段最後一句「To celebrate the launch...」。
qs.trans: 使用者如何獲得三次免費騎乘？
qs.e: 最後一句說明「anyone who downloads the AetherRide mobile app before October 31 will receive three complimentary 30-minute rides」，只要在 10 月底前下載手機 App 即可獲得三次免費騎乘，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (D) 月票為 $29 不限次數騎乘，並非送三次免費騎乘的條件；(B) 文中未提推薦好友；(C) 每趟本來就規定要還到站點，並無因此贈送三次免費騎乘。

qs.q: Who was scheduled to lead the morning workshop that Mr. Holloway originally selected?
o: Trevor Nairn
Maya Lin
Sonia Verma
Dr. Julian Cho
qs.h: 先在第二篇信件找出 Mr. Holloway 上午選了哪個場次（Session A2），再回第一篇時程表查誰主講。
qs.trans: Holloway 先生原本選擇的上午工作坊是由誰主講？
qs.e: 第二篇第一段 Mr. Holloway 提到「I selected Session A2 for the morning slot」，對照第一篇時程表，Session A2（Sustainable Packaging Solutions）的主講人是 Dr. Julian Cho，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) Sonia Verma 主講 Session A1；(A) Trevor Nairn 主講 Session A3；(B) Maya Lin 是午宴主題演講者。

qs.q: Why does Mr. Holloway want to change his afternoon workshop?
o: He wants to hear Chloe Park speak about visual merchandising.
A colleague from his company is already attending Session B2.
Session B2 has been canceled by the organizers.
His flight back home was moved to an earlier time.
qs.h: 查看第二篇第二段關於 Fiona Bell 的說明。
qs.trans: Holloway 先生為何想更換他的下午工作坊？
qs.e: 第二篇第二段說明，他們公司的物流經理 Fiona Bell 也要參加高峰會且同樣報名了 Session B2，為了讓兩人能涵蓋更多不同主題（cover more topics between the two of us），他想改聽別場，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (D)(C) 文中未提及；(A) 他想改聽的是提升線上結帳率（improving online checkout rates，即 Carlos Mendez 主講的 Session B1），而非 Chloe Park 的 B3。

qs.q: Which room does Mr. Holloway hope to move to at 1:30 P.M.?
o: Crystal Ballroom
Room 208
Room 201
Room 204
qs.h: 他在第二篇說想改聽「improving online checkout rates」，對照第一篇下午 1:30 是哪一場、在哪一間教室？
qs.trans: Holloway 先生希望下午 1:30 改去哪一間教室？
qs.e: 第二篇提到他想改聽「improving online checkout rates」，對應第一篇下午場次「Session B1 (Room 201): E-Commerce Checkout Optimization」，地點在 Room 201，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (D) Room 204 是他原本報名的 Session B2；(B) Room 208 是 Session B3（視覺陳列）；(A) Crystal Ballroom 是午宴地點。

qs.q: Why was Mr. Holloway unable to modify his schedule in the mobile app?
o: He had not paid the conference luncheon fee.
The deadline for app changes had already passed.
The mobile app only works on Android devices.
He forgot his registration number.
qs.h: 比對第一篇底部的 *Note 截止日期（November 10）與第二篇信件的寄信日期（November 11）。
qs.trans: 為什麼 Holloway 先生無法在手機 App 中修改行程？
qs.e: 第一篇底部的備註明載「Attendees who wish to switch sessions must submit a change request via the summit app by November 10」，而第二篇 Mr. Holloway 是在 11 月 11 日早上才嘗試修改，已超過 11 月 10 日的截止期限，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (D) 主旨欄已寫出報名編號 #RS-7741；(C)(A) 文中均未提及。

qs.q: Where will summit attendees be at 12:15 P.M.?
o: In Room 201
In Room 204
In Room 208
In the Crystal Ballroom
qs.h: 查看第一篇時程表中 11:45 A.M.–1:15 P.M. 的活動與地點。
qs.trans: 高峰會與會者在中午 12:15 會在哪裡？
qs.e: 根據第一篇時程表，11:45 A.M.–1:15 P.M. 為交流午宴與主題演講（Networking Luncheon），地點在 Crystal Ballroom，12:15 P.M. 正好落在此時段內，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A)(B)(C) 皆為上下午分組工作坊的教室，中午時段並無課程。

qs.q: What is included at no extra charge in the Corporate Stay & Meet Package for a group of 12 guests?
o: Airport shuttle service every half hour
One-on-one IT support in each suite
Evening dinner in the Atrium Dining Room
Full-day rental of the Cedar Boardroom
qs.h: 查看第一篇廣告中「groups of 10 or more guests」享有的四項福利。
qs.trans: 12 人團體預訂「企業住宿與會議專案」可免費享有下列哪一項服務？
qs.e: 第一篇列出 10 人以上團體專案包含「Round-trip airport shuttle service running every 30 minutes」（每半小時一班的往返機場接駁服務），故選 (A)。
qs.w: (D) 會議室租借是享 75 折（25% discount），並非免費；(C) 免費附贈的是自助早餐（Hot breakfast buffet），而非晚餐；(B) 套房提供免費高速 Wi-Fi，未提一對一 IT 支援。

qs.q: Which conference room is the most suitable and cost-effective choice for Veritas Pharma on March 19?
o: The Atrium Dining Room
The Maple Room
The Oak Hall
The Cedar Boardroom
qs.h: 第二篇第二段提到會議室需要容納 18 位學員 + 2 位講師（共 20 人），對照第一篇哪一間容量剛好符合？
qs.trans: 3 月 19 日對 Veritas 製藥而言，哪一間會議室最合適且最具成本效益？
qs.e: 第二篇指出會議室需容納「18 participants plus two visiting instructors」（共 20 人）。對照第一篇：Cedar Boardroom 僅容納 12 人（太小），Maple Room 可容納至多 25 人（$400/天，最合適），Oak Hall 可容納 60 人但價格昂貴（$680/天），故選 (B) The Maple Room。
qs.w: (A) Atrium Dining Room 是吃早餐的餐廳；(D) 最多 12 人，坐不下 20 人；(C) 60 人大廳超出需求且較貴。

qs.q: How much will Veritas Pharma pay for the Maple Room on March 19 after the package discount?
qs.h: Maple Room 原價 $400/天，專案享有 25% discount（75 折），計算 $400 × (1 - 0.25)。
qs.trans: 套用專案折扣後，Veritas 製藥在 3 月 19 日租借楓木廳需支付多少費用？
qs.e: 第一篇顯示 Maple Room 標準全日定價為 $400，而企業專案享有全日會議室租金 25% 折扣（75 折），因此折扣後價格為 $400 × 75% = $300，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) $180 是 Cedar Boardroom 打 75 折後的價格；(D) $240 是 Cedar Boardroom 的原價；(C) $400 是未打折前的原價。

qs.q: Why does Veritas Pharma qualify for the complimentary afternoon coffee and pastry service?
o: Its seminar is taking place on a Thursday.
It is renting the largest conference hall.
It is booking 18 suites for two consecutive nights.
Arthur Pendelton is a loyalty club member.
qs.h: 對照第一篇底部 *Special Bonus 的兩個條件（至少 15 間套房、連住兩晚以上）與第二篇的訂房內容。
qs.trans: 為什麼 Veritas 製藥符合免費午間咖啡與糕點服務的資格？
qs.e: 第一篇 *Special Bonus 規定「reserve at least 15 guest suites for two or more consecutive nights」，而第二篇說明他們有 18 位業務代表各住一間套房（18 間 ≥ 15 間），且從 3 月 18 日週三住到 3 月 20 日週五退房（連住兩晚），完全符合條件，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A)(D)(B) 皆非廣告所列的贈送條件。

qs.q: Who is Arthur Pendelton?
o: A shuttle bus driver at Manchester Airport
One of the visiting seminar instructors
A sales manager at The Crestwood Suites
A training coordinator at Veritas Pharma
qs.h: 查看第二篇信末的署名職稱。
qs.trans: Arthur Pendelton 是誰？
qs.e: 第二篇電子郵件結尾署名「Arthur Pendelton, Training Coordinator, Veritas Pharma」，即 Veritas 製藥的培訓協調員，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) 他是寫信向飯店訂房的客戶；(A)(B) 與信末職稱不符。

qs.q: What is indicated about the SD-100 desk?
o: Its height must be adjusted by hand.
It is the largest desk in the collection.
It is available in a walnut finish.
It has built-in USB charging ports.
qs.h: 比對第一篇三款桌子的規格，逐一檢查選項。
qs.e: 第一篇寫 SD-100 是「Manual crank height adjustment」（手搖曲柄調整高度），也就是必須手動調整，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (C) SD-100 只有白色與黑色；(D) USB 充電孔是 SD-300 才有；(B) 最大的桌面是 SD-300 的 160 × 80 公分。
qs.trans: 關於 SD-100 升降桌，文中指出了什麼？

qs.q: Why did Ms. Brooks most likely choose the SD-200?
o: It is the least expensive model in the collection.
It meets her needs without features she does not require.
It is the only model with an electric motor.
It includes free delivery for any number of desks.
qs.h: 先列出 Ms. Brooks 在第二篇提出的條件，再到第一篇看哪一款剛好符合。
qs.e: 第二篇的條件是：電動調高、至少三組記憶高度、不需要 USB 孔、要胡桃木色。第一篇中 SD-100 是手動的；SD-200 是電動、有 3 組記憶、有胡桃木色；SD-300 雖然也符合，但多了她不需要的 USB 孔且較貴。所以 SD-200 剛好符合需求又沒有多餘功能，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 最便宜的是 SD-100；(C) SD-300 也有電動馬達；(D) 免費運送的條件是訂購五張以上。
qs.trans: Brooks 女士最可能為什麼選擇 SD-200？

qs.q: In the e-mail from Ms. Brooks, the word "match" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
o: replace
compete with
be equal in number to
go well with
qs.h: 把每個選項代回原句「To ___ our new conference table」，看哪個意思通順。
qs.e: To match our new conference table, we would like the walnut finish 的意思是「為了和新會議桌搭配」，這裡的 match 指顏色、風格相配，與 go well with 最接近，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (B) 與…競爭；(C) 在數量上相等；(A) 取代，代回原句都不合理。
qs.trans: 在 Brooks 女士的電子郵件第一段中，match 一字的意思最接近下列何者？

qs.q: Why will Ms. Brooks probably need to change her order?
o: The SD-200 model is no longer being produced.
The black finish costs more than the walnut finish.
Walnut desks will not arrive before her office opens.
She ordered too few desks to receive free delivery.
qs.h: 比對第二篇的期限與第三篇的出貨日期。
qs.e: 第二篇說新辦公室 6 月 2 日啟用，桌子必須在那之前送達；第三篇說胡桃木桌延到 6 月 9 日才出貨，晚於啟用日，所以她可能需要改單（例如改黑色），故選 (C)。
qs.w: (D) 她訂了六張，已符合免運條件；(A) 只是胡桃木貼皮延誤，型號仍在生產；(B) 文中沒有提到不同顏色價格不同。
qs.trans: Brooks 女士為什麼可能需要更改訂單？

qs.q: What does Mr. Pratt ask Ms. Brooks to do?
o: Send the measurements of her new office
Visit the showroom to see the black finish
Pay a deposit for the temporary desks
Tell him her decision by a certain date
qs.h: 看第三篇最後一段對 Ms. Brooks 的要求。
qs.e: 第三篇最後寫「Please let me know which option you prefer by May 9.」，請她在 5 月 9 日前告知選擇哪個方案，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) 臨時桌是免費提供（at no cost）；(B)(A) 文中都沒有提到。
qs.trans: Pratt 先生請 Brooks 女士做什麼？

qs.q: What is indicated about the workshop series?
o: Participants must register at the library in person.
The workshops are held on weekends.
Library cardholders do not have to pay to attend.
Each session lasts two hours.
qs.h: 逐一核對第一篇公告的時間、費用與報名方式。
qs.e: 第一篇寫「Workshops are free for Harborview Library cardholders」，持借書證者免費參加，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (D) 6:30 到 8:00 是一個半小時；(A) 報名方式是上網（Register online）；(B) 工作坊在週三晚上舉行。
qs.trans: 關於這個工作坊系列，文中指出了什麼？

qs.q: Why did Mr. Menon write to Ms. Kim?
o: He will be unavailable on his scheduled date.
He would like to move his session to a larger room.
He wants to change the topic of his workshop.
He needs the library to provide a laptop.
qs.h: 看第二篇第一段他提出什麼請求、理由是什麼。
qs.e: 第二篇說客戶請他 3 月 11 日去芝加哥參加產品發表會，所以無法在原定日期上課，請求改期，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (C) 他沒有要求更換主題；(B) 沒有提到教室大小；(D) 攜帶筆電是第三篇對學員的建議。
qs.trans: Menon 先生為什麼寫信給 Kim 女士？

qs.q: Who will lead the workshop on March 11?
o: Ravi Menon
Alan Cho
Gloria Estes
Priya Desai
qs.h: 第三篇說哪兩場交換了日期？再回第一篇查那一場的講者。
qs.e: 第三篇說 Bookkeeping Basics 改到 3 月 11 日；第一篇顯示 Bookkeeping Basics 的講者是會計師 Alan Cho，所以 3 月 11 日由 Alan Cho 主講，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) Menon 原本是 3 月 11 日，現已改到 3 月 18 日；(C) Estes 是 3 月 4 日；(D) Desai 仍是 3 月 25 日。
qs.trans: 3 月 11 日的工作坊由誰主講？

qs.q: Where will the social media workshop take place?
o: In the main reading room
At Brightpath Digital's office
In Room A
In Room B

The fee for nonmembers has recently increased.

The speakers are all employees of the library.

They must be delivered within 10 kilometers.
They must be paid for with a credit card.
They must include at least 30 meals.

qs.w: (D) 30 人是贈送甜點盤的門檻，不是下單條件；(C) 文中沒有規定付款方式；(B) 10 公里外也能送，只是要收運費。

qs.q: How much did Mr. Lau's company most likely pay per person for food?

qs.trans: Lau 先生的公司餐點最可能每人付多少錢？

o: The salad was missing from the buffet.

The pasta was not hot when it arrived.
An item that his group qualified for was not delivered.
qs.h: 第二篇提到價目表承諾的東西沒送來，回第一篇確認他們為什麼有資格拿到。

qs.trans: Lau 先生為什麼對這次訂單感到失望？

qs.h: 第三篇說退了哪一筆費用？再回第一篇查那筆費用的金額。

view
plan
supervision

docs.text:
Service Date: July 22 | Technician: Marco Bellini
Client: FreshMart Supermarket (Branch #14 — Elmwood Ave.)
Equipment: Walk-In Dairy Cooler (Model: PolarMax 800)

Inspection Findings:
Arrived at 9:15 A.M. in response to an urgent call from store manager Kendra Shaw regarding rising temperatures inside the walk-in dairy cooler (measured at 9°C; normal operating range is 1°C–4°C).

1. Condenser Coils: Heavily coated with dust and debris, restricting airflow. Cleaned thoroughly on-site.
2. Door Gasket: Rubber seal along the bottom edge of the main door is torn, allowing warm air to leak into the unit. Replaced with a new PolarMax seal from service van inventory.
3. Evaporator Fan Motor: Bearing is worn out and making a loud grinding noise. The motor is still running at reduced speed but must be replaced soon to prevent complete failure. Because the specific motor (Part #PM-44B) is out of stock locally, I have ordered it directly from the manufacturer.

Follow-Up Required:
Part #PM-44B is scheduled to arrive at our warehouse on July 27. A follow-up visit has been booked for July 28 at 8:00 A.M. to install the new motor.

docs.text:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to update you on the refrigeration issue at the Elmwood Avenue store this morning. When our morning shift arrived at 7:00 A.M., the walk-in dairy cooler alarm was sounding. We immediately moved all milk, yogurt, and cheese crates into the backup meat-and-produce chiller, so no inventory was spoiled.

Borealis HVAC sent a technician out within two hours. Cleaning the coils and replacing a damaged door seal brought the cooler temperature back down to 3°C by noon, and we have moved the dairy products back in.

However, the technician noted that one internal component is worn and needs a replacement part that won't arrive until next week. Once he returns on July 28 to install that part, I will ask him to inspect our frozen-food display cases as well, since they haven't had their annual maintenance check yet.

Best,
Kendra Shaw
Store Manager, Branch #14

qs.trans: Clara Jenkins 為她的秋季工作坊總共支付了多少費用？
qs.e: 第一篇顯示數位旅遊攝影學費為 $195。第二篇 Clara 提到自己住在 Oakwood（享學費 9 折：$195 × 0.9 = $175.50），且於 9 月 15 日報名（早於 9 月 20 日早鳥期限，免收 $25 行政報名費），因此總共支付 $175.50，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) $195.00 是未打折的學費；(B) $200.50 是打了 9 折卻誤加上 $25 報名費；(D) $220.00 是原價 $195 加上 $25 報名費。

qs.q: Which room does Clara Jenkins suggest improving?
o: Studio 2
The Ceramics Lab
Media Room B
The Teaching Kitchen
qs.h: 她在第二篇建議在她的上課教室多加幾台電腦，對照第一篇攝影課在哪間教室上課？
qs.trans: Clara Jenkins 建議改善哪一間教室？
qs.e: Clara 在第二篇建議在她的攝影課教室增加裝有修圖軟體的電腦，而第一篇明載數位旅遊攝影的上課地點為「Media Room B」，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) Studio 2 是水彩教室；(B) Ceramics Lab 是陶藝教室；(D) Teaching Kitchen 是烘焙廚房。

qs.q: What activity does Clara Jenkins plan to try in the winter term?
o: Baking sourdough bread
Making ceramic items
Painting landscapes
Editing travel videos
qs.h: 查看第二篇最後一句「sign up for Kenji Sato's class in the winter term」，再對照第一篇 Kenji Sato 教什麼。
qs.trans: Clara Jenkins 打算在冬季班嘗試什麼活動？
qs.e: 第二篇最後一句說她打算在冬季班報名 Kenji Sato 的課程，對照第一篇，Kenji Sato 教授的是「Wheel-Thrown Pottery（手拉坯陶藝：製作碗、馬克杯與花瓶）」，即製作陶器，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (C) 風景畫是 Helene Vance 的課；(D) 簡章無影片剪輯課；(A) 酸種麵包是 Marie Laurent 主廚的課。

qs.q: What is NOT a requirement for the position?
o: Availability on weekends
Knowledge of Spanish
Fluency in English
Experience at a hotel front desk
qs.h: NOT 題：把四個選項逐一和第一篇的 Requirements 對照。
qs.e: 第一篇列出的必要條件是兩年櫃台經驗、葡萄牙語與英語流利、可輪週末班；西班牙語是「a plus but not required」（加分但非必要），故選 (B)。
qs.w: (C)(D)(A) 都列在 Requirements 中。
qs.trans: 下列何者「不是」這個職位的必要條件？

qs.q: What qualification does Ms. Ribeiro have that is NOT mentioned in the advertisement?
o: She has worked at a hotel front desk.
She can work on weekends.
She can speak French.
She speaks Portuguese fluently.
qs.h: 比對第二篇她列出的能力與第一篇廣告的條件，找出廣告沒有提到的那一項。
qs.e: 第二篇她提到自己有不錯的法語能力（working knowledge of French），而第一篇只提到葡萄牙語、英語與西班牙語，完全沒有提到法語，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (B)(D)(A) 都是第一篇廣告列出的條件。
qs.trans: Ribeiro 女士具備的哪一項資格是廣告中「沒有」提到的？

qs.q: Why does Ms. Ribeiro mention May 6 and May 7?
o: She will be away for a training course.
She will start a new job in Madrid.
She wants to visit the hotel before applying.
She will be training new staff at her hotel.
qs.h: 看第二篇第二段她提到這兩天的原因。
qs.e: 第二篇說她 5 月 6、7 日要在馬德里參加訓練課程（attending a training course in Madrid），所以那兩天無法面試，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (D) 她在現職訓練新人，但和這兩天無關；(B) 她是去上課，不是到馬德里上新工作；(C) 文中沒有提到。
qs.trans: Ribeiro 女士為什麼提到 5 月 6 日和 7 日？

qs.q: What can be concluded about Ms. Ribeiro's interview?
o: It has been canceled.
It will take place in Madrid.
It will be conducted by video.
Her request regarding the date was accepted.
qs.h: 比對第二篇她的請求與第三篇的時程表。
qs.e: 第二篇她請求把面試安排在 5 月 8 日；第三篇時程表顯示她的面試在 May 8, 9:30 A.M.，表示她的請求被接受了，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) 面試地點是飯店二樓會議室，不是視訊；(B) 面試在里斯本的飯店舉行；(A) 她的名字仍在時程表上。
qs.trans: 關於 Ribeiro 女士的面試，可以得出什麼結論？

qs.q: Who is Carla Mendes?
o: The person who wrote the job advertisement
A manager who will interview the candidates
A receptionist at the Hotel Lumen
A candidate for the position
qs.h: 看第三篇時程表的第一行。
qs.e: 第三篇寫「Interviewer: Carla Mendes, Front Office Manager」，她是負責面試的櫃台經理，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (D) 應試者名單中沒有她；(C) Lumen 飯店是 Ribeiro 女士的現職；(A) 文中沒有說明廣告由誰撰寫。
qs.trans: Carla Mendes 是誰？

qs.q: What is indicated about Riverside Event Hall?
o: It does not allow events to end after 10:00 P.M.
It provides catering for all events.
It offers discounts to groups of more than 50 people.
It charges more for events held on weekends.
qs.h: 逐一核對第一篇的各項規定。
qs.e: 第一篇寫「A 20% surcharge applies to all Saturday and Sunday bookings」，週末預訂要加收 20%，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (B) 文中沒有提到外燴；(C) 沒有提到人數折扣；(A) 沒有提到結束時間的限制。
qs.trans: 關於 Riverside 活動館，文中指出了什麼？

qs.q: On the Web page, the word "less" in the last line is closest in meaning to
o: fewer
smaller
minus
without
qs.h: 把選項代回「a full refund, less a $50 processing fee」，看哪個意思通順。
qs.e: a full refund, less a $50 processing fee 指「全額退款，但要扣掉 50 美元手續費」，這裡的 less 是介系詞「減去」，與 minus 最接近，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (B)(A) smaller、fewer 是比較級形容詞，不能這樣用；(D) without 會變成「不含手續費的全額退款」，意思相反。
qs.trans: 在網頁最後一行中，less 一字的意思最接近下列何者？

qs.q: Why was the Terrace Room most likely selected for Tallis Design?
o: It is the smallest room that can hold all of the employees.
It is the least expensive room for a full-day rental.
It is the only room with audiovisual equipment.
It is available only on Saturdays.
qs.h: 第二篇提到人數與「不要太大」的需求，回第一篇比對各場地容量。
qs.e: 第二篇說有 65 人，希望場地夠大但不要太空曠；第一篇中花園廳只能容納 40 人，露台廳可容納 80 人，大禮堂可容納 200 人。露台廳是能容納所有人的最小場地，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (C) 影音套組是另外加購，每間都可以租；(D) 文中沒有這項限制；(B) 他們租的是半天，而且最便宜的是花園廳。
qs.trans: 露台廳最可能為什麼被選為 Tallis 設計的場地？

qs.q: Why does the invoice include a $110 charge?
o: The party will last more than four hours.
The party will be held on a Saturday.
Mr. Osei asked for extra microphones.
The deposit was paid after the deadline.
qs.h: 第三篇的 $110 是什麼名目？再回第一篇查這筆費用的規定。
qs.e: 第三篇的 $110 是 Weekend surcharge (20%)；第一篇規定週六、週日預訂加收 20%，而派對在週六（$550 × 20% = $110），故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 派對 6 點到 10 點，正好四小時，符合半天租借；(C) 麥克風包含在 $150 的影音套組裡；(D) 文中沒有提到逾期付款。
qs.trans: 帳單上為什麼有一筆 110 美元的費用？

qs.q: If Mr. Osei canceled the booking on September 20, how much would he receive back?
qs.h: 先確認 9 月 20 日距離活動有沒有超過 14 天，再看他已經付了多少錢。
qs.e: 9 月 20 日距離 10 月 18 日超過 14 天，依第一篇規定可全額退款但扣除 50 美元手續費。第三篇顯示他目前只付了 405 美元訂金，所以可拿回 $405 − $50 = $355，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (D) $405 是已付的訂金，沒有扣手續費；(C) $760 是總額 $810 扣掉 $50，但他尚未付清總額；(B) $810 是帳單總額。
qs.trans: 如果 Osei 先生在 9 月 20 日取消預訂，他會拿回多少錢？

qs.q: What is Ms. Hart scheduled to do on October 13?
o: Fly back to Boston
Visit Fernwood Supplies' factory
Meet with representatives of Dalton Tech
Attend an industry exhibition
qs.h: 看第一篇 10 月 13 日的行程，注意同義改寫。
qs.e: 第一篇 10 月 13 日的行程是 North American Packaging Expo（全天的包裝博覽會），也就是參加產業展覽，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) 與 Dalton Tech 開會是 10 月 12 日；(A) 回程原定 10 月 15 日；(B) 與 Fernwood 開會是 10 月 14 日，而且文中沒有說是參觀工廠。
qs.trans: Hart 女士 10 月 13 日原定要做什麼？

qs.q: Why is the new schedule for Flight NA 208 a problem for Ms. Hart?
o: She would miss the opening of the expo.
She would have to pay an additional fare.
She would arrive after her meeting with Dalton Tech begins.
She would not be able to check in to her hotel.
qs.h: 比對第二篇新的抵達時間與第一篇當天的第一個約會。
qs.e: 第二篇說 NA 208 改為下午 2:25 抵達；第一篇顯示她當天下午 2:00 要與 Dalton Tech 開會。新班機抵達時會議已經開始，所以她在第三篇要求改搭較早班機，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (D) 文中沒有提到入住時間的限制；(A) 博覽會在 10 月 13 日；(B) 改搭 NA 204 不需加價。
qs.trans: NA 208 班機的新時刻為什麼對 Hart 女士造成問題？

qs.q: What does Northair offer to passengers on Flight NA 208?
o: A discount on a future flight
A free change to a different flight
An upgrade to a higher class of service
A hotel room in Toronto
qs.h: 看第二篇第二段航空公司提供的選擇。
qs.e: 第二篇說乘客可以改搭 NA 204「at no additional cost」（不需額外費用），也就是免費改搭其他班機，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A)(D)(C) 文中都沒有提到；另一個選項是全額退款，不是折扣。
qs.trans: Northair 提供 NA 208 班機乘客什麼？

qs.q: Which appointment does Ms. Hart want to reschedule?
o: Her visit to the expo
Her meeting on October 14
Her meeting on October 12
Her flight on October 12
qs.h: 第三篇她想請誰改時間？再回第一篇查那個約會原本在哪一天。
qs.e: 第三篇她請 Ben 問 Fernwood Supplies 能否改在 10 月 13 日下午見面；第一篇顯示與 Fernwood Supplies 的會議原定 10 月 14 日上午，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (C) 10 月 12 日的會議是 Dalton Tech，她想準時參加；(A) 博覽會是主辦單位提早結束，不是她要改；(D) 改搭較早班機是「換班機」，題目問的是要改期的約會（appointment）。
qs.trans: Hart 女士想要更改哪一個約會的時間？

qs.q: If Fernwood Supplies agrees to her request, how many nights will Ms. Hart stay at the Kingsley Hotel?
o: One
Four
Three
Two
qs.h: 第一篇原本住幾晚？第三篇說如果對方同意，她要怎麼調整？
qs.e: 第一篇原定 10 月 12 日入住、15 日退房，共 3 晚；第三篇說如果 Fernwood 同意，她會在 14 日飛回並少住一晚，所以只住 12、13 日兩晚，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 少了兩晚，與「少住一晚」不符；(C) 三晚是原定的住宿；(B) 文中沒有這種安排。
qs.trans: 如果 Fernwood Supplies 同意她的請求，Hart 女士會在 Kingsley 飯店住幾晚？
